text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top two panels: ICON global's wind speed over ICON-EU's, fortnightly, in blue at the generator with the steps and grey at the other two; 1 means the two agree. Pale bars: the mean of each period at the generator with the steps. Bottom: error difference, added after the first run. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026. All rows are exploratory.'
text.tspan: Top two panels: ICON global's wind speed over ICON-EU's, fortnightly, in blue at the generator with the steps and
grey at the other two; 1 means the two agree.
Pale bars: the mean of each period at the generator with the steps.
Bottom: error difference, added after the first run.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile
Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026.
